understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Activated goals are completed when stepped on, and completing all goals advances to the next level.
